mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 PM, it is 75 degrees with clear skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. A Waning Gibbous moon is lighting up the sky, and you can catch the space station passing overhead tomorrow at 3:31 AM, moving from the northwest over Verona High School toward the east northeast near Fitchburg. The overnight low will be 72 degrees with no rain predicted.

The City of Verona has officially installed the Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture at Century School Park. This public art piece was created by artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland from a reclaimed ash tree to honor traditional Tai Chi movements.

There is plenty to do this week, starting with the Verona Downtown Farmers Market, yoga at Insight Wellness, and trivia at The Bogey Factory all happening tomorrow. Plus, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company this Thursday.

In a weekly update from the Verona Police Department, officers handled a call on August 28 involving a motor vehicle collision on South Nine Mound Road where the driver was cited for inattentive driving.

Today's flavor was Chocolate Heath Crunch. As the store is currently closed for the night, please join us tomorrow starting at 10 AM, when we will be featuring the OREO REESE'S Cheesecake flavor of the day.
